name: Pascal Editor
description: Models 3D buildings with rooms, walls, roofs and furniture in the browser or locally, and lets architects connect Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to edit scenes over MCP.

skills.name: Room Modeling
skills.description: Creates rooms, walls, doors, windows, stairs and roofs in a building scene with semantic tools such as create_room and add_door.

skills.name: Furnish Room
skills.description: Furnishes a room with catalog items placed on floors, walls or ceilings, with collision checks and measurements.

skills.name: View Scene
skills.description: Returns a picture of the project from a chosen view, including an eye-level view from inside a room, on the hosted server.

skills.name: Verify and Save
skills.description: Validates the scene with verify_scene, saves it with save_scene and reports version status with get_project_status.
